verdict.rationale: Ramp is a corporate card platform where freezing/replacing lost cards is a standard, expected capability, but no evidence item describes card freezing or replacement workflows — only card issuance speed (ramp-comm-2) and unrelated features (receipts, AP automation, bill pay, ERP sync) are covered. Missing for 10: any documentation or community mention of freezing a lost/stolen card, ordering a replacement, or related self-service card controls.
